name: create_identity
description: Create a brand new agent identity from scratch. This creates the full directory structure (id.json, ego/skills/, ego/knowledge/, superego/) so the identity can immediately be used in harnesses. Use list_identities first to check existing identities.

role.description: The role/title of this agent (e.g. '研究专家', 'Code Reviewer', '辩论裁判')

description.description: Detailed description of what this agent does, its expertise and responsibilities

llm_model.description: LLM model name to use. Default: uses the system default model.

llm_base_url.description: LLM API base URL. Default: uses the system default.

task_prompt.description: Optional superego task prompt that constrains this agent's behavior

skills_to_copy_from.description: Optional: comma-separated identity names to copy skills from (e.g. 'coder,dante'). Copies all skills from those identities.
